objects.name: Stealth Falcon
objects.description: [Stealth Falcon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0038) is a threat group that has conducted targeted spyware attacks against Emirati journalists, activists, and dissidents since at least 2012. Circumstantial evidence suggests there could be a link between this group and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) government, but that has not been confirmed. (Citation: Citizen Lab Stealth Falcon May 2016)
objects.description_fa: [Stealth Falcon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0038) یک گروه تهدید است که حداقل از سال 2012 حملات جاسوسی هدفمندی را علیه خبرنگاران، فعالان و مخالفان اماراتی انجام داده است. (Citation: Citizen Lab Stealth Falcon May 2016)
